The '''DecipherCon 1999 Team Event''' was a Star Wars CCG team side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Virginia Beach, Virginia). It is separate from the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]] held at the same convention. A team of four won it: [[Paul Todd Feldman]], [[Maarten Logghe]], [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] and Unknown.<ref name="drazin">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/ErikDark.html Feldman's Drazin Deck: Decipher Con Team Play Winning Deck], Paul Todd Feldman, Torch Industries. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000303173004/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/ErikDark.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="harvest">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/Erik.html Feldman's Harvest Deck], Paul Todd Feldman, Torch Industries. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011105084834/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/Erik.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="drtorch">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b9f9tNBiU2I SWCCG PDS2: DRTORCH Worlds Finalist 1996, 1997, 1999, 2000 Interview] (BillBisco2, 29 May 2025; auto-captions). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014143045/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b9f9tNBiU2I Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Date:''' November 1999
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]], [[Maarten Logghe]], [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] and Unknown

Feldman published both decks on [[Torch Industries]]: the Drazin deck as his "Decipher Con Team Play Winning Deck"<ref name="drazin" />, and Harvest under the heading "Regional Qualifier/DecipherCon Team Winning Deck". On Harvest he wrote:<ref name="harvest" />

<blockquote>"A version of this deck won me the Regional and the Team Event at Deciphercon."</blockquote>

The Drazin deck has [[Endor]] cards and no [[Death Star II]] cards, and Torch Industries first shows it on 3 March 2000, which places the event at DecipherCon 1999.

== Team ==

In a 2025 interview Feldman showed a 1999 Decipher Champ plaque from the team event and said:<ref name="drtorch" />

<blockquote>"I'm the champion for 99 of world of the team. ... They did a team championship. So, I was the only American on it and I think it was Martin Logan. It might have been Bastion and somebody else. I can't remember who was on the team, but it was we won it as a team event."</blockquote>

He also said the team was four players and that its name was something like "three Europeans an American", with him as the American.<ref name="drtorch" /> Martin Logan is [[Maarten Logghe]] and Bastion is [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]. The fourth teammate is Unknown.

On how the event ran, he said teams played against other teams (not each other), with cumulative points and differential, and that his last game decided the win:<ref name="drtorch" />

<blockquote>"I think the way they ran it is we had cumulative points as our win records and our differential as a team. ... We were just we had individual games but what we didn't play each other because we're on the we played other teams. ... I remember I had to win my game for us to win it"</blockquote>
